name: pickup_spawn_list_remove_and_free_node
description: PickupSpawnList::RemoveAndFreeNode unlinks a spawn from a spawn list, destroys its pickup object when present, and frees the spawn node.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The native pickup spawn-list smoke verifies head/tail/count unlinking through Clear, while the remove-same-opt smoke verifies direct RemoveAndFreeNode use on head and tail nodes during saved-next iteration.
